children: President Donald Trump's latest financial disclosure shows a series of large technology stock trades in July, with his investment accounts selling sizable positions in Microsoft (MSFT) and Amazon (AMZN) while adding shares of Nvidia (NVDA).
The filing lists Microsoft sales valued at $5 million to $25 million on July 20. Three days later, the accounts purchased another $100,001 to $250,000 of Microsoft shares.

Amazon also saw heavy activity. The accounts sold $5 million to $25 million of Amazon stock on July 20 before buying between $1,001 and $15,000 on July 23. The disclosure does not provide an explanation for the transactions.
Nvidia moved in the other direction, with the accounts purchasing between $500,001 and $1 million of its shares on July 20.

The trades were part of 1,156 securities transactions reported for July. The combined value was estimated at roughly $79 million to $270 million, while the filing provides value ranges rather than exact amounts for individual transactions.

title: President Trump Sells Millions in Microsoft and Amazon, Buys Nvidia Stock
